title: docs(qa): re-point integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application to ADR-0143 D1
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8GSHyok4gtTqiuFPQqn87RM)_
Fixes #29154
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台清单 `integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application` 一项，把「oauth2 无可编写拼法（企业层）」改指向现行契约，revision 5 → 6。
- 为什么改：ADR-0143 D1 已把出站连接器 OAuth 放进开源层，oauth2 实例本就该能编译；旧条款让发版清单（#29151）每轮红一格，而产品是对的。
- 风险与回滚：只改一份 QA 清单 JSON，不发布、不动代码；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json` 该项的 `acceptance[3]` 与 `negative[1]`（新判据）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`，预期打印 `check-platform-checklist: OK`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One item of `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`, `integration-system.connector-auth-kind-application`, keys `title`, `variants[5]`, `steps[4]`, `acceptance[3]`, `negative[1]`, `automated.ref`, `source[0]`, `revision` 5 → 6 and one `history` row (ref #29154). `steps[4]` joined the surface by the seat's Claim amendment on #29154.

Revision 5 asserted that `auth: { type: 'oauth2' }` fails parse because `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` has "exactly the four static arms". On main it has seven strict arms (`none`, `bearer`, `api-key`, `basic`, `oauth2`, `app-credential`, `signed`), per ADR-0143 D1 (Accepted 2026-10-28), which reverses the ADR-0097 §3 enterprise placement. The re-pointed clause keeps every refusal that still holds and adds the ones ADR-0143 D3 brings, so it is no weaker:

- an inline secret is refused by name (`unrecognized_keys` at `auth`, pointing at `credentialRef`) on every kind, the three new ones included;
- `oauth2` keys are strict: `clientSecret` meets the `credentialRef` guidance, `accessToken` / `refreshToken` the runtime-token guidance;
- an `oauth2` auth without `grant` fails at `auth.grant`; an unknown kind fails at `auth.type`;
- the #7990 inline-`authentication` refusal stands unchanged;
- the well-formed `oauth2` control (`grant: 'client_credentials'`, `tokenUrl`, `clientId`, `credentialRef`) must build clean, and `negative[1]` now scores its refusal as a FAIL against D1.

`acceptance[3].verify` drops its note about `connector.test.ts` parsing oauth2 under `AuthConfigSchema` (that runtime variant was retired by ADR-0143 D7) and cites the three per-kind pins: `connector-auth-static-kinds.test.ts`, `connector-auth-grant-kinds.test.ts`, `connector-auth-signed.test.ts`.

## Why

QA run #29151 (18.3.0 wave 4, `7fa9873f`) failed `acceptance[3]` and `negative[1]`: the card's oauth2 repro compiles and boots. The product follows the ADR, so the clause is stale spec (checklist-test §5), not a defect.

## Tests

No code changed. The new clause was measured on main `0d15f895` with a throwaway schema probe (deleted before commit) through `DeclarativeConnectorEntrySchema`:

<details><summary>probe readings</summary>

```text
card-repro OK
grant-less (entry) invalid_union @ auth.grant  "Invalid discriminator value. Expected 'authorization_code' | 'client_credentials'"
clientSecret   unrecognized_keys @ auth ["clientSecret"]  (oauth2 client_credentials, credentialRef guidance)
accessToken    unrecognized_keys @ auth ["accessToken"]
refreshToken   unrecognized_keys @ auth ["refreshToken"]
app-cred secret unrecognized_keys @ auth ["appSecret"]
signed secret  unrecognized_keys @ auth ["secret"]
bearer token   unrecognized_keys @ auth ["token"]
inline authentication  custom @ authentication  "Provider-bound connector instance ... must not inline secrets via `authentication` ..."
oauth1         invalid_union @ type  "Expected 'none' | 'bearer' | 'api-key' | 'basic' | 'oauth2' | 'app-credential' | 'signed'"
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No checklist item yet covers the per-dispatch grant kinds (`oauth2`, `app-credential`, `signed`) at runtime: connect, refresh, sign. The card scoped a sibling item out; it is reported to the seat as a finding, not added here.
- No pin feeds an `oauth2` auth with no `grant` or with an inline `accessToken`; the clause tells the runner to drive those two builds by hand, and `automated.ref` says so.
